rosterLimitation: The workflow preflight established that the disposable Claude profile is not signed in. Claude is excluded rather than counted as free or available; this pilot compares the three connected Codex subscription models only.

independentChecks: Inspect the saved solution for scope and avoid granting credit for worker assertions alone
criticalFailures: A write escapes the case workspace

independentChecks: Map material factual claims to the SQLite source
Check that inference and uncertainty are labeled
Confirm the memo answers concurrency limits, not only WAL setup
criticalFailures: A material claim conflicts with the cited primary source
A cited link was not opened or does not support its claim
The requested memo is missing or unusable

independentChecks: Count words with one frozen tokenizer across all modes
Check purpose, audience, three capabilities and a measurable finish line
Compare every factual statement with brief.md
Assess clarity without using Jev's verdict
criticalFailures: Invents a live-provider, daily-use or production outcome
The requested draft is missing or materially outside the length constraint

independentChecks: Open the actual DOCX with the native DUKE document inspection path
Render and inspect every page for clipping, blank pages and legibility
Compare dates, owners, budget, statuses, decision and open question with brief.md
Check that invented examples or estimates are labeled
criticalFailures: The file is corrupt or is not a real DOCX
A supplied fact or arithmetic total is materially wrong
Invented completion or commitment is presented as fact

modes.selection: Normal Jev automatic model-and-effort choice among Astra, Sol and Luna
modes.effort: selected by Jev from advertised supported efforts

independentEvaluator.blinding: Review artifact copies labeled only by randomized receipt key where practical; deterministic checks run before identity is revealed.
independentEvaluator.limitations: The evaluator is a Codex model and is not independent of Codex as a provider. Jev review is retained as raw evidence but is never the benchmark acceptance verdict.

claimBoundary: Four development cases can reveal defects and compare these exact runs. They do not establish general savings, calibrated routing quality or the held-out release threshold.
